overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission approved several license transfers and special permits, tabled a temporary late-hours policy, and referred a noise complaint regarding a local pub to the city's legal department.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from April 15 and May 20, 2026.

items.title: License Transfer - Heritage Liquors and Market
items.summary: Approved the transfer of an all-alcoholic beverages license from Bargain Spot Liquors to Chandrika Corporation d/b/a Heritage Liquors and Market, approved Sagar Patel as manager, and authorized financing pledges.

items.title: License Transfer and Entertainment License - Rassos Grill
items.summary: Approved the transfer of license and an entertainment license for Rassos Food Network LLC d/b/a Rassos Grill.

items.title: License Transfer - Merced Two Holdings LLC
items.summary: Approved the transfer of Snappy Patties' license to Merced Two Holdings LLC d/b/a Rory O'Connor, conditional upon updated corporate filings, application signatures, and verified operating hours.

items.title: Temporary One-Hour Operating Extension Discussion
items.summary: Tabled action on adopting a blanket one-hour extension option for on-premise licensees, opting to review requests on a case-by-case basis while declining to establish entertainment districts.

items.title: Special One-Day License - EventDem
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for EventDem to host a fashion show on July 18, 2026.

items.title: Entertainment License Complaint - Mrs. Murphy's Pub
items.summary: Referred an ongoing noise complaint and entertainment license review request from a neighboring business owner regarding Mrs. Murphy's Pub to the law department for legal advice.

items.title: Common Victualler Compliance - Asian Taste
items.summary: Agreed to hand-deliver a notice to Asian Taste requiring completion of outstanding Common Victualler paperwork within one week under threat of license suspension.
